head: working-tree
baseline_note: The baseline was captured as one green `npm run check` at f7c3caa before any edit. `scripts.check` is &&-chained, so a green aggregate ENTAILS all 8 gate exits were 0 — a derivation, not an assumption. HEAD exits were measured per-gate individually.
bound: This compares the exit codes of the project's OWN deterministic gates at baseline vs HEAD. It catches exactly what those gates catch, nothing more. 'no-regressions' NEVER means 'nothing broke' (P0).
